description: Use this to decide whether a tender is worth your user's time. Pass tender_id plus company_profile (sector, capabilities, brands, certifications, in the user's words) and/or supplier_id (the user's tax id, e.g. Chilean RUT). Andes checks evidence it holds: the company's terms (with procurement synonyms) in the tender's title, items and description; the supplier's past awards in the same UNSPSC product category; the estimated amount against the supplier's usual award; and whether it already sold to this buyer. Returns fit (strong, possible, weak, insufficient_evidence), relevance_score 0-1, signals (each with status, strength, evidence and source), gaps (what would improve the judgment), the buyer's competition context (average bidders, usual winners) and agent_guidance. Without supplier_id the score is capped: text cannot prove capability. It does not read tender documents yet. Treat it as evidence; the decision is your user's. Access: needs an identified agent key (free, self-service at https://pass.andesprotocol.com).
name: assess_fit
title: Assess tender fit for a supplier
